title: 相當可以
body:
UI簡潔漂亮，大部分需要的功能都有了，有些數據可以自動去Apple的「健康」App裡面抓，非常方便！
近期還更新了繁體中文！超級推薦！
author: Bluebedpurpledreams

title: multiple account sync choices
body:
Finally, I found an app that can directly execute the habit in the widget.
But as the title suggests, I hope there are multiple synchronization options！

body:
